command:
set -eu
for target in /tmp /dev/shm; do
  script="$target/.hardening-exec-test"
  dev="$target/.hardening-device-test"
  printf '#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n' | sudo tee "$script" >/dev/null
  sudo chmod 4755 "$script"
  if "$script" 2>/dev/null; then printf 'FAIL executable on %s\n' "$target"; exit 1; else printf 'PASS noexec %s\n' "$target"; fi
  sudo mknod "$dev" c 1 3
  if dd if="$dev" of=/dev/null bs=1 count=1 2>/dev/null; then printf 'FAIL device usable on %s\n' "$target"; exit 1; else printf 'PASS nodev %s\n' "$target"; fi
  printf 'SETUID_FILE '; stat -c '%n mode=%a' "$script"
  sudo rm -f "$script" "$dev"
done
printf '\nEFFECTIVE_OPTIONS\n'
findmnt -no TARGET,OPTIONS /tmp
findmnt -no TARGET,OPTIONS /dev/shm
printf '\nPERSISTENT_CONFIG\n'
awk '$2 == "/tmp" || $2 == "/dev/shm" { print }' /etc/fstab
